How it works

Simple from first text to launch day

Everything can be handled by text or email — no phone call required if that's not your thing.

STEP 1

Free consultation

Text or email me about your business and what you need. I'll tell you honestly what I'd recommend — and what you don't need.

STEP 2

Clear written quote

You get the full price in writing before anything starts. 50% deposit books your project — no surprises later.

STEP 3

Design & revisions

I build your site and send you a preview link. You review it on your phone, send feedback, and I revise until it feels right.

STEP 4

Launch & grow

Your site goes live, the balance is due, and if you're on a marketing plan, the Google, social, and ads work begins.
